mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “WAN”?
options: Each packet routed independently.
Wide Area Network spanning cities or continents.
Forwards packets between networks.
Dedicated path reserved for the call.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “LAN”?
options: Local Area Network, small geographic scope.
Dedicated path reserved for the call.
Data chunk with header and payload.
Each packet routed independently.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Packet switching”?

Dedicated path reserved for the call.
Each packet routed independently.
Local Area Network, small geographic scope.
